name: Honda NC700X
engine: 670 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected, manual or DCT
intro: Honda's practical commuter-adventure twin. Check the drive chain and starter relay recalls.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2012 NC700Xs were in recall 12V461 because the drive chain plates may not have been hardened correctly. Some 2014-2016 NC700s were in recall 15V439 for the starter relay switch.
A-002.reason: A broken chain or a stall can cause a crash. Repairs are free.

G: DCT bikes need the DCT clutch and filter serviced on schedule.

recalls.what: Drive chain plates may not be properly hardened and can fracture.
recalls.fix: Dealer inspects and replaces the chain free.
